input.answer_text: Plan: stamp each item with a last-advanced time, add a stall detector that compares it with the expected cadence, and raise a stall item when a stage stops. Each stage would record why it did not advance.
input.goal: A queue of the system's own work items can stop moving at any stage, and nothing notices except a person reading logs. Make the system notice by itself when a stage stops advancing, and treat that as a work item of its own.
input.verdict_reason: The plan addresses every part of the request with a detector and a new kind of item raised automatically.
